settings.title: Reactions plugin settings
settings.max-reactions-per-post: Maximum unique reactions per post (0 for unlimited, default: 4)
settings.max-reactions-per-user-per-post: Maximum reactions per user per post (0 for unlimited)
The limit is enforced only when adding a new reaction and not when joining an existing reaction.
settings.allow-self-reactions: Allow users to react to their own posts
settings.allow-self-reactions-help: By default post authors cannot add reactions to their own posts. Reacting to your own post never gives reaction reputation.
settings.max-reactions-per-message: Maximum unique reactions per message (0 for unlimited, default: 4)
settings.max-reactions-per-user-per-mess: Maximum reactions per user per message (0 for unlimited)
The limit is enforced only when adding a new reaction and not when joining an existing reaction.
settings.allowed-post-reactions-help: Restrict which emojis can be used as reactions on posts. Leave empty to allow all emojis. Does not affect chat message reactions.
settings.reaction-reputations-help: You can assign a reputation to individual reactions. When a reaction is applied to a post, the owner of that post will get this reputation.
settings.delete-notification-on-remove: Delete the notification when the reaction is removed
settings.delete-notification-on-remove-h: When a user takes back an emoji reaction, the notification that was sent to the author is deleted. Turn this off to keep the notification even after the reaction was removed. Applies to posts and chat messages.
settings.delete-notification-on-unvote: Delete the notification when the forum's built-in upvote ("like") is removed
settings.delete-notification-on-unvote-h: This is about NodeBB's own upvote button, not the emoji reactions of this plugin. When a user takes back their upvote, the notification the author received for it is deleted. Turn this off to keep it.
